other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a religious minority community of Karnataka
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Applicant must have at least SSLC qualification
Applicant must not have previously taken training under any state or central government scheme
Applicant must compulsorily complete the training
benefits_summary: Provides training in Heavy Vehicle Driving, Short Hand, Security Services, Office Soft Skills, Retail Sales, and Beauty Parlor courses for both males and females.
